# Contributor instructions

Run `mise install`, `mise run setup` once, then `mise run ci`. The single entrypoint in scripts/check.py runs policy validation, actionlint, zizmor, every Python contract test, and reference drift checks. Hosted contract-tests.yml also exercises actual reusable adapters and artifacts. Regenerate docs/reference.md with `python scripts/reference.py` after contract changes.

Reusable workflows checkout the consumer repository: never call this library's scripts or expect its tasks at runtime. Consumer tasks own language-specific commands and dependency ordering. Do not reintroduce shared caller-workflow concurrency into validation jobs. Protect writer events/environments and keep credentials confined to publishing steps. Pin external actions and reusable workflows to full SHAs and containers to digests. Treat input changes as public API changes; update migration notes and caller examples. Preserve security guards and compare exact hosted revisions before calling a release tested.
